cited.quote: Corona pandemic relief measures – Distribution of Grocery kits to the Rice Family Cardholders

rationale: C4 is a one-off COVID relief grocery kit including 500 gm sugar, not an additional 1 kg of sugar at ration shops. C1-C3 and C5 concern sugar mills and sugarcane. No official step for the commitment.

rationale: C5 issues guidelines for a pilot urban wage employment scheme for the urban poor, and C4 funds MGNREGS; these are related employment programmes, not a scheme creating 10 lakh jobs a year for youth. C1-C2 describe entrepreneurship and loan schemes. No step for the commitment.
C1 is Kalvi TV, C2-C3 minimum wages, C4 lockdown, C5 Namakku Naame Thittam guidelines. None concerns the work period of Home Guards.
C1-C3 cover industrial parks and IT SEZs, C4 urban works guidelines, C5 an Independence pillar in Chennai. None mentions a Vallalar International Center in Vadalur.

C2 mentions OBC reservation in medical All India Quota, a different issue; C1, C3-C5 concern exams, NEEDS, MGNREGS and Finance Commission grants. No extract is about urging a higher OBC income ceiling.

cited.quote: paddy Grade-A varieties will be procured at Rs.2060/- per quintal

rationale: C2, a budget speech, announces an increased incentive bringing paddy procurement to Rs.2060/2015 per quintal, below Rs.2500, and gives no GO. A budget announcement is not operationalisation. C1/C3 concern sugarcane prices. Not started.

cited.quote: Hence, a detailed assessment of all the jewel loans disbursed

rationale: C3 (budget speech) says the jewel loan waiver is on the agenda but a detailed assessment is required before it is taken up; no GO or waiver order. C4 covers SHG loans; C1, C2, C5 are RTI allocations. Not started.

cited.quote: A State Level Advisory Committee for all major Hindu temples will be constituted

rationale: C5 (Governor's address) states the committee will be constituted, an intent only. C1 lists temple measures without the committee; C2-C3 constitute a NEET committee, C4 a promotion committee. No GO constituting the temple advisory committee.

rationale: C1/C3 are an insurance scheme for government employees, a different beneficiary group; C2/C4/C5 are Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam home care with CAPD linked to existing CMCHIS. None regularises the schemes or provides 100% coverage for heart, cancer and kidney conditions.

cited.quote: Increasing milk production by safeguarding the health of livestock.

rationale: C2 (budget speech) lists livestock health as an objective of a village panchayat scheme, a mention without a dedicated measure for veterinary camps. C1, C3-C5 are unrelated GOs. Directional commitment: not started.

cited.quote: evict the residential encroachments in objectionable poramboke lands by identifying alternate Government land

rationale: C1/C4 extend a pre-existing scheme (2019) to regularise or relocate residential encroachments on poramboke land; water bodies are not mentioned and it continues earlier activity. C2 is an audit of a school encroachment, C3 an erratum. No step specific to encroachments along water bodies.

cited.quote: an exhibition building of 44,360 sq. mtrs along with multilevel car parking, food court

rationale: C1 mentions multilevel car parking only as part of the Chennai Trade Centre expansion, not a public city parking facility. C2-C5 concern employment, industrial parks and urban works. No step for multi-level city parking.

cited.quote: pump sets and generators for permanent remedial measures to tackle inundation of flood

rationale: C2/C3 sanction highways flood works including generators for the Highways Department, not generators for police stations, hospitals and revenue offices. C1 is budget intent on police and disaster funds; C4-C5 are lockdown GOs. Not started.

C3 lists temple measures but nothing on separate darshan queues for senior citizens; C1, C2, C4, C5 concern reservation rosters, pensions, e-Sevai and hospital lists. No extract is about the commitment.

cited.quote: has enacted Act No.8 of 2021, thereby offering special reservation to Most Backward Classes

rationale: C3 revises the public-service roster for MBC sub-reservation and C2 states intent on recruitment priority and 69% reservation; neither raises women's reservation in government jobs to 40%. C1, C4, C5 are unrelated. Not started.
